detail.title: Proposal: teach set-v2 the redaction corpus and retained lookup (unblocks pinned redaction legs)

detail.reason:
Build circuit closed: the blamed commit was never broken — the circuit's cargo check ran against the shared tree carrying two dead-predecessor WIP compile errors. Repaired in-tree (uncommitted, by design), and committed main verified build-green from the blamed commit to close-time HEAD.

ROOT CAUSE. git show abe037a6:tests/restore_export_unknown_field_conformance.rs still pins .tempdir_in("/var/tmp"); the clean_beads_free_base() helper carrying the E0277 (bases.first().copied() on Vec<PathBuf>, "PathBuf: Copy") existed only as uncommitted WIP: (1) the beadrs-e4acee24 tempdir sweep had added that helper to 27 test files, every copy with .copied() — cargo stops at the first failing target, so 26 were latent; (2) the beadrs-2ac26b9a set-v2 straggler rewrite left tests/sync_configure.rs with inner.unwrap() on a DirEntry (E0599).

REPAIR (working tree only; deliberately uncommitted — every touched file was another bead's WIP, and committing them under this bead would claim their work): 27x .copied() -> .cloned() restoring each author's evident intent (Option<&PathBuf> -> Option<PathBuf>), plus dropping the one stray DirEntry unwrap. Shared-tree cargo check --all-targets --quiet --keep-going went exit 101 -> exit 0; rustfmt --edition 2024 --check clean on all touched files. The owning beads then landed the work legitimately: 31c63c0e (e4acee24's close, concurrency_recovery_variants) and d628f2a7 + 60f5a12d (3b100c9b adopting the sweep for the full gate) — all carrying the .cloned() form. git status shape unchanged by the repair (no new files, no status transitions; nothing staged; no commit under this bead).

VERIFIED GREEN ON COMMITTED MAIN (clean git-archive extractions, private target dirs under /build/bead-rs, workspace crate compiled from each extraction path):
- abe037a6 (the blamed commit): cargo check --all-targets --quiet exit=0 — the circuit's exact failing command passes on the commit it blamed.
- 31c63c0e: cargo build --all-targets exit=0 (108 crates, 1m47s).
- cb2f5228 (close-time HEAD, after the sweep landed): cargo build --all-targets exit=0 (1m23s).
- DoD --fast on the abe037a6 extraction (BEAD_DOD_TMPBASE=/data/build/bead-rs): fmt leg green; cargo test leg red only on the pre-existing main red below. origin/main..HEAD empty.

PRE-EXISTING MAIN RED (deterministic, clean extractions of 857f7433, 6aafdc1c, abe037a6, 31c63c0e — a test failure in the checkpoint-publication thread, NOT a build failure, and not this bead's scope): tests/checkpoint_tombstones.rs::tombstones_applied_and_object_set_bounded exits 101 (~1.5s) — after flush 1 the set-v2 gen-0 set/manifest-gen-*.json referenced by previous.json is missing from disk (left = [objects/<hash>.jsonl], right adds the manifest). beadrs-2ac26b9a's notes list tombstones among the "14 now GREEN" targets at 857f7433; that green does not reproduce in a clean extraction, so the split family should re-verify its green list. Same thread as the concurrency_recovery_variants red that beadrs-e4acee24 scoped as pre-existing (fails on parent dd79a2d0).

```verified:
cargo build --all-targets exit=0
```

Rewrote the three redaction-family targets onto the checkpoint-set-v2 spec 9 contract (commit 7bce11a0, pushed). A forced sharded request publishes set-v2, so the retained-generation reset leg asserts pointer mode set-v2, the checkpoint-fingerprint leg accepts set/shard/ selectors, the storage round-trip reads the set-v2 manifest's class=="redaction" shards, and the duplicate-secret sweep fixture counts checkpoint copies instead of per-shard spread. No leg asserts the retired forced-sharded-v1 pointer mode or shard-path layout anymore.

The redaction_storage:193 duplicate-record-ID finding was NOT dissolved by the fixture rewrite: it is a corpus-writer defect (keyed_record_id partitions an acknowledged redaction finding and its acknowledgment into one prefix space). A second same-family defect also surfaced: checkpoint_issue_paths has no set-v2 arm, so the retained redaction lookup rejects set-v2 pointers ("unsupported mode", masked as "could not scan retained checkpoint redaction targets"). Filed blocking proposal bead beadrs-9116e1a9 (proposal-pending, human) with repro, root cause, the verified-but-uncommitted WIP fixes, and un-pin instructions; pinned the five set-v2 legs with contract notes naming it. With the WIP src fixes applied on a clean extraction all three targets pass UNPINNED 11/11, 5/5, 5/5 in the parent verification env; monolithic legs keep coverage behind the pins at HEAD.

All verification ran on private clean extractions of pushed 7bce11a0 under /data/build/bead-rs/, never the shared dirty tree; fmt and clippy clean.

All three Install facts plus the wrong-crate warning are present on pushed HEAD 7bce11a0, confirmed in a clean git-archive extraction (/data/build/bead-rs/a0f78f12-verify.Rua8uw); the worktree README is byte-identical to HEAD. git status before staging shows only pre-existing rival state (beadrs-e4acee24 WIP in src//tests/, .beads checkpoint churn) — nothing staged, nothing committed, and origin/main..HEAD was already empty, so there is nothing to push.

This is the exact pre-existing main red documented in today's terminal close of the build-circuit bead (event seq 29005), where it was reproduced across clean extractions of 857f7433, 6aafdc1c, abe037a6 and 31c63c0e; this run is the fifth independent reproduction, now on HEAD 7bce11a0 — a checkpoint-publication thread failure owned by that repair line, not by this README-only bead. PRE-EXISTING RED DISCLOSED (discovery, unowned, NOT this bead's scope): cargo test --test readme_build_paths exits 101 at 7bce11a0 — tests/readme_build_paths.rs:30 and :64 assert README sections ("Build artifacts", "### Verifying the build", CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/build/<repo>) that parent-reorg commit 5c90ebbe moved to BUILD_PROCEDURE.md (git log -S pin; the content exists in BUILD_PROCEDURE.md, so docs truth moved rather than regressed).
